Single-learner boundary view

One learner at a time: one model, one repeat, one fold. The coloured field is that learner's prediction on a regular grid of log P × log VX, at one spot-radius slice and with the fourth input ST held fixed. The learner was refitted on its own first b paid simulations (startup included). Diamonds = its paid runs (in query order). Circles = the same fold's held-out runs. Only runs near the LS slice and ST value are drawn.
